description_en: This API is used to retrieve the list of publishing users in a channel, sorted in descending order by their online duration
description_zh: 本接口用于获取频道内发布端的用户列表（按用户在线时长降序）
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-channel-top-pub-user-list --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1615893133 --destroyed-ts 1615893757 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChannelTopPubUserList

parameters.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of channel creation. Supports querying data from the last 30 days, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
parameters.description_zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp of channel creation. Supports querying data from the last 30 days, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds

parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.description_en:
The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was released, in seconds. If this parameter is empty, data up to the current time will be retrieved.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, the system returns data from the Creation Time to the actual release time.
parameters.description_zh:
释放频道的时间戳，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
